assets.pause: Use case: stylized-concept. A finished borderless full-screen PAUSE MENU BACKGROUND for an original dark medieval game BABEL, detailed painterly digital game art matching a midnight blue gothic ruined tower and tarnished gold knight armor. 16:9 landscape. A quiet abandoned roadside chapel at night, with a small weathered stone saint bust and rolled teal banner entirely at the far left below mid-height, an extinguished gilded incense vessel and small warm candle at far right below mid-height, a few ivy leaves and fallen stone fragments restricted to bottom 12 percent. The entire central 70 percent width, from top down to 82 percent height, must remain smooth very dark blue-black atmospheric empty space with subtle soft haze, extremely low contrast and no objects, to hold title and 2-column buttons clearly. No enclosing architectural arch, no frame, no rectangular border, no ornaments across the top, no text, no glyphs, no UI. Full bleed scene extending beyond edges, tasteful understated still-life, pause/rest mood not a busy battle. Crisp landscape high resolution.
assets.runes: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a high resolution full bleed dark inventory page background for BABEL, a medieval theological fantasy adventure. Landscape 16:9. Deep charcoal blue-black aged vellum and fine worn slate, subtle warm bronze acanthus and curling vine filigree engraved faintly in the far corners and lower outer edges, original design, no rectangular frame or enclosing border. Center 85 percent width must be dark quiet uniform low contrast empty space for golden rune icons and readable text. No text, no symbols, no slots, no objects or jewels in the center. Delicate ornament only at edges, not a panel or parchment scroll. Balanced, restrained, tactile, manuscript inspired, high definition. Background extends to every edge and can be cropped to different screen proportions.
assets.logo: Use case: background-extraction. Input is the user's old game title screen. Extract ONLY the BABEL title logo in the upper left, together with its original curling ornamental flourish above and below, including the small downward sword at bottom center. Preserve the exact original B-A-B-E-L decorative capital letterforms, arrangement, and scrollwork design. Remove the entire painting, landscape, START GAME and QUIT GAME buttons. Output a tightly framed standalone logo with a small safety margin, real transparent background and transparent spaces between letters and filigree. Change the black ink logo to warm ivory-gold for visibility on a dark background, clean sharp edges, high resolution, no extra slogans or additional text. Do not copy or include any part of the painting. Horizontal logo composition approx 2:1.
assets.ring: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE original high definition circular selection wreath icon for a medieval fantasy rune inventory, transparent background including completely empty transparent center. A perfect centered circular ring built from elegant curling acanthus leaves, very fine interwoven vines and manuscript arabesques, balanced mirrored scrollwork, four small pointed leaf tips at cardinal directions. Antique champagne gold, warm ivory-gold highlights, bronze fine recesses, crisp restrained carved metal detail, slender airy filigree with generous cutouts. Ring outer diameter 82 percent of square canvas, transparent center diameter 59 percent. No rune in center, no letters, no text, no jewel, no square border, no background shadow, no watermark. High resolution square production sprite. Must remain readable around an icon at 100px display size, avoid overly dense hairlines.
